pictures.scene: Jan Porcellis, Vissersboten in onrustig water - small fishing boats heeling over in a grey choppy sea with the spray breaking across them, the opening cry Save me, O God

pictures.scene: Fyodor Vasilyev, Dooi - a thaw turning the road to black water and mud with two small travellers wading out into it, the waters up to my neck and the sinking into the miry depths
pictures.name: pd_vasilyev_dooi

pictures.scene: Mihaly Munkacsy, Vrouw met takkenbos - a woman labouring over broken ground under her heavy bundle of sticks with nothing firm under her feet, where there is no footing and the drift into deep waters
pictures.name: pd_munkacsy_vrouw_met_takkenbos

pictures.scene: Francis Danby, Bergstroom - a mountain torrent pouring white down the rocks and filling the whole gorge, where the flood engulfs me and I am weary from my crying
pictures.name: pd_danby_bergstroom

pictures.scene: Carlos de Haes, Boerderij bij Elche - a baked dry farmstead under a hard pale sky with the ground cracked and colourless, my throat is parched and my eyes fail
pictures.name: pd_de_haes_boerderij_bij_elche

pictures.scene: Jan van Huchtenburgh, Dobbelspel om het leven - armed men crowding round a table to throw dice for a man's life, those who hate me without cause
pictures.name: pd_huchtenburgh_dobbelspel_om_het_leven

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, Hallali van het hert - the whole pack closing on the cornered stag in the snow, many are those who would destroy me
pictures.name: pd_courbet_hallali_van_het_hert

pictures.scene: Jan van Hemessen, De onbarmhartige dienstknecht - the servant seized by the throat over a debt at the money table, though I did not steal, I must repay
pictures.name: pd_hemessen_onbarmhartige_dienstknecht

pictures.scene: Jan Lievens, Het feestmaal van Esther - the hidden thing spoken out at the king's table and the guilty man exposed, You know my folly and my guilt is not hidden from You
pictures.name: pd_lievens_het_feestmaal_van_esther

pictures.scene: Friedrich Wilhelm Schadow, De wijze maagden - the waiting maidens with their lamps still burning and their faces lifted, may those who hope in You not be ashamed through me
pictures.name: pd_schadow_de_wijze_maagden

pictures.scene: Eugene Burnand, Hogepriesterlijk gebed - Christ at prayer with His face raised in the dark, the appeal to the Lord GOD of Hosts for all who seek Him
pictures.name: pd_burnand_hogepriesterlijk_gebed

pictures.scene: Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, Wekenfeest - a household of Israel keeping the feast together in their own room, O God of Israel, for I have endured scorn for Your sake
pictures.name: pd_oppenheim_wekenfeest

pictures.scene: Jakub Schikaneder, Avondstraat - a lone figure walking an empty evening street past shuttered houses, shame has covered my face and I have become a stranger to my brothers
pictures.name: pd_schikaneder_avondstraat

pictures.scene: John Pettie, De wake van de ridder - a young man keeping his night vigil alone before the altar, a foreigner to my mother's sons because zeal for Your house has consumed me
pictures.name: pd_pettie_wake_van_de_ridder

pictures.scene: Emile Friant, Allerheiligen - mourners filing past the graveyard gate on All Saints' day with a beggar's hand held out to them, the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me, I wept and fasted
pictures.name: pd_friant_allerheiligen

pictures.scene: Carl Spitzweg, Aswoensdag - a man shut in a bare cell on Ash Wednesday in his penitent's clothes, it brought me reproach and I made sackcloth my clothing
pictures.name: pd_spitzweg_aswoensdag

pictures.scene: Vasily Perov, Kloostermaaltijd - the well-fed men at the refectory table laughing while the poor stand unnoticed at the door, I was sport to them and those who sit at the gate mock me
pictures.name: pd_perov_kloostermaaltijd

pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, In een Romeinse herberg - the tavern company loud over their wine, and I am the song of drunkards
pictures.name: pd_bloch_in_een_romeinse_herberg

pictures.scene: John Glover, Landschap bij Patterdale - the long valley opening into clear light with the lake quiet below, my prayer to You is for a time of favor
pictures.name: pd_glover_landschap_bij_patterdale

pictures.scene: Constantin Meunier, Mijnwerkers bij de schacht - miners hauled up out of the pit at the end of the shift, answer me with Your sure salvation and rescue me from the mire
pictures.name: pd_meunier_mijnwerkers_bij_de_schacht

pictures.scene: Theodore Gudin, Zeeslag bij Alicudi - a ship going down in smoke and heavy sea with men in the water, do not let me sink, deliver me from my foes
pictures.name: pd_gudin_zeeslag_bij_alicudi

pictures.scene: Wassily Kandinsky, Stormachtige zee bij Rapallo - the sea heaped up grey and white against the shore, do not let the floods engulf me
pictures.name: pd_kandinsky_stormachtige_zee_bij_rapallo

pictures.scene: Carl Friedrich Lessing, Rotslandschap met ruine - a black cleft in the rock dropping away below a ruined tower, let not the Pit close its mouth over me
pictures.name: pd_lessing_rotslandschap_met_ruine

pictures.scene: Jacek Malczewski, Aankondiging - the angel come close to a man at work in the open field, Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good
pictures.name: pd_malczewski_aankondiging

pictures.scene: Adam Camerarius, Christus en de hoofdman - the centurion kneeling in the road and Christ turning to him, turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion, hide not Your face from Your servant
pictures.name: pd_camerarius_christus_en_de_hoofdman

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Het zieke kind - the family crowded round the bed of the sick child, for I am in distress, answer me quickly
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_het_zieke_kind

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, De ontmoeting van David en Abigail - Abigail kneeling in the road to turn the armed king aside and save her house, draw near to my soul and redeem me, ransom me because of my foes
pictures.name: pd_rubens_ontmoeting_van_david_en_abigail

pictures.scene: Jorg Breu the Elder, De menigte roept tegen hem - the crowd pressing in with their mouths open against one man, You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace, all my adversaries are before You
pictures.name: pd_breu_de_menigte_roept_tegen_hem

pictures.scene: Nikolay Kasatkin, Wezen - orphan children left standing with nobody to take them in, insults have broken my heart and I am in despair
pictures.name: pd_kasatkin_wezen

pictures.scene: Jozef Israels, Het naaistertje - the young seamstress bent alone over her work in a bare room, I looked for sympathy but there was none, for comforters but I found no one
pictures.name: pd_israels_het_naaistertje

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, Kruisiging met de hoofdman - the sponge lifted on the reed to the Lord on the cross, they gave me vinegar to quench my thirst
pictures.name: pd_cranach_kruisiging_met_de_hoofdman

pictures.scene: Matthias Stom, Esau verkoopt zijn eerstgeboorterecht - the bowl set on the table and a birthright lost over it, may their table become a snare and a trap
pictures.name: pd_stom_esau_verkoopt_zijn_eerstgeboorterecht

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, Riviergezicht bij maanlicht - the river country sunk in darkness with only a thin moon on the water, may their eyes be darkened so they cannot see
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_riviergezicht_bij_maanlicht

pictures.scene: Wincenty Dmochowski, Bosbrand - the forest going up in a wall of fire, pour out Your wrath upon them and let Your burning anger overtake them
pictures.name: pd_dmochowski_bosbrand

pictures.scene: Julius von Klever, Winterlandschap met brug - an abandoned place under snow with no smoke and no one on the road, may their place be deserted, let there be no one to dwell in their tents
pictures.name: pd_klever_winterlandschap_met_brug

pictures.scene: Altobello Melone, Christus draagt het kruis - Christ under the cross with the mob jeering at the wounds already given Him, they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded
pictures.name: pd_melone_christus_draagt_het_kruis

pictures.scene: Adriaen Brouwer, Drinkende boeren in de herberg - men heaping one drunken night on the last in a smoky tavern, add iniquity to their iniquity, let them not share in Your righteousness
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_drinkende_boeren_in_de_herberg

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, Portret van een koopman - the merchant at his desk among the slips and ledgers where every name is written down, may they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_portret_van_een_koopman

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, Gebed in de hof van olijven - Christ kneeling in pain in the garden while the angel is sent to Him, I am in pain and distress, let Your salvation protect me
pictures.name: pd_bellini_gebed_in_de_hof_van_olijven

pictures.scene: Judith Leyster, De serenade - a player singing out with his head thrown back and his instrument lifted, I will praise God's name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving
pictures.name: pd_leyster_de_serenade

pictures.scene: Constant Troyon, Ossen op weg naar het ploegland - the yoked oxen driven up to the field in the morning light, this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves
pictures.name: pd_troyon_ossen_op_weg_naar_het_ploegland

pictures.scene: Ludwig Knaus, De poezenmoeder - a poor old woman's face lit up with delight over the kittens in her lap, the humble will see and rejoice, let your hearts be revived
pictures.name: pd_knaus_de_poezenmoeder

pictures.scene: Valery Jacobi, Rustplaats van de gevangenen - exiles halted by the roadside milepost, women in headcloths, a sleeping child and an old man with his face covered, the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people
pictures.name: pd_jacobi_rustplaats_van_de_gevangenen

pictures.scene: Hendrick Dubbels, Kalme zee - a Dutch vessel mirrored in glassy water under an immense pale sky, let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them
pictures.name: pd_dubbels_kalme_zee

pictures.scene: Johannes Christiaan Karel Klinkenberg, Het Binnenhof - workmen's benches and trestles set up in the sunlit arcade of the old court, God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah
pictures.name: pd_klinkenberg_het_binnenhof

pictures.scene: Franz von Defregger, Sommerfrische - a mother seated at her own doorway with a small girl standing by and a toddler on the ground beside her, that they may dwell there and possess it, the descendants of His servants will inherit it
pictures.name: pd_defregger_sommerfrische

pictures.scene: Johannes Warnardus Bilders, Landschap met boerenwoning - a thatched cottage among the oaks with a woman carrying her basket home along the sandy track, those who love His name will settle in it
pictures.name: pd_bilders_landschap_met_boerenwoning

lines: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David.
Save me, O God,
for the waters are up to my neck.
I have sunk into the miry depths,
where there is no footing;
I have drifted into deep waters,
where the flood engulfs me.
I am weary from my crying;
my throat is parched.
My eyes fail,
looking for my God.
Those who hate me without cause
outnumber the hairs of my head;
many are those who would destroy me—
my enemies for no reason.
Though I did not steal,
I must repay.
You know my folly, O God,
and my guilt is not hidden from You.
May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me,
O Lord GOD of Hosts;
may those who seek You not be dishonored through me,
O God of Israel.
For I have endured scorn for Your sake,
and shame has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers
and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
because zeal for Your house has consumed me,
and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
I wept and fasted,
but it brought me reproach.
I made sackcloth my clothing,
and I was sport to them.
Those who sit at the gate mock me,
and I am the song of drunkards.
But my prayer to You, O LORD,
is for a time of favor.
In Your abundant loving devotion, O God,
answer me with Your sure salvation.
Rescue me from the mire
and do not let me sink;
deliver me from my foes
and out of the deep waters.
Do not let the floods engulf me
or the depths swallow me up;
let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
Answer me, O LORD,
for Your loving devotion is good;
turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
Hide not Your face from Your servant,
for I am in distress.
Answer me quickly!
Draw near to my soul and redeem me;
ransom me because of my foes.
You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace.
All my adversaries are before You.
Insults have broken my heart,
and I am in despair.
I looked for sympathy, but there was none,
for comforters, but I found no one.
They poisoned my food with gall
and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
May their table become a snare;
may it be a retribution and a trap.
May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see,
and their backs be bent forever.
Pour out Your wrath upon them,
and let Your burning anger overtake them.
May their place be deserted;
let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
For they persecute the one You struck
and recount the pain of those You wounded.
Add iniquity to their iniquity;
let them not share in Your righteousness.
May they be blotted out of the Book of Life
and not listed with the righteous.
But I am in pain and distress;
let Your salvation protect me, O God.
I will praise God’s name in song
and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
And this will please the LORD more than an ox,
more than a bull with horns and hooves.
The humble will see and rejoice.
You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
For the LORD listens to the needy
and does not despise His captive people.
Let heaven and earth praise Him,
the seas and everything that moves in them.
For God will save Zion
and rebuild the cities of Judah,
that they may dwell there and possess it.
The descendants of His servants will inherit it,
and those who love His name will settle in it.
